vanilla.definition: A fragrant flavouring made from vanilla plants.

chocolate.definition: A sweet food made from roasted and ground cocoa beans.

strawberry.definition: A small red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface.

mint.definition: A cool-tasting herb flavor used in ice cream.

cookie-dough.definition: Unbaked cookie mixture, or an ice-cream flavor containing prepared cookie-dough pieces.

caramel.definition: Firm chewy candy made from caramelized sugar and butter and milk.

mango.definition: A tropical fruit with sweet yellow or orange flesh, used as an ice-cream flavor.

pistachio.definition: An edible nut with a pale green kernel, used to flavor ice cream.

coffee.definition: A beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans.

bubblegum.definition: Associated with bubblegum, especially its sweet flavor, distinctive aroma, or bright pink color.

scoop.definition: A rounded portion of ice cream served with a scoop tool.

cone.definition: A crisp edible cone used to hold ice cream.

sundae.definition: Ice cream served with a topping.

milkshake.definition: Frothy drink of milk and flavoring and sometimes fruit or ice cream.

sorbet.definition: A frozen dessert usually made from fruit, water, and sugar without dairy.

gelato.definition: A soft, dense Italian frozen dessert made from milk or cream, sugar, and flavorings, with little air mixed into it.

frozen-yogurt.definition: A smooth, frozen dessert made from yogurt sweetened and flavored with ingredients such as fruit or vanilla.

popsicle.definition: Ice cream or water ice on a small wooden stick.

float.definition: A drink with ice cream floating in it.

banana-split.definition: A dessert made from a banana cut lengthwise and served with scoops of ice cream, sauces, nuts, and whipped cream.

sprinkles.definition: Small colorful sugar or chocolate pieces used to decorate desserts.

whipped-cream.definition: Cream beaten until it becomes light and airy.

hot-fudge.definition: A thick chocolate sauce served warm over ice cream.

caramel-sauce.definition: A sweet sauce made with caramelized sugar.

nuts.definition: Hard-shelled seeds or fruits often eaten as food.

cherry.definition: A small fruit, often used as a topping for ice cream.

cookie-crumble.definition: Small broken pieces of cookies used as a topping.
cookie-crumble.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Cookie Crumble" in an educational description.

gummy-bears.definition: Chewy sweets shaped like small bears.

marshmallow.definition: A soft sweet food that becomes sticky when heated.

chocolate-chips.definition: Small pieces of chocolate used in baking or as a topping.

waffle-cone.definition: A crisp cone with a waffle pattern, used to hold ice cream.

sugar-cone.definition: A sweet, crisp cone used to hold ice cream.

straw.definition: A narrow tube used to drink liquid.

napkin.definition: A small piece of table linen that is used to wipe the mouth and to cover the lap in order to protect clothing.

lid.definition: A movable top or cover (hinged or separate) for closing the opening at the top of a box, chest, jar, pan, etc.

tray.definition: An open receptacle for holding or displaying or serving articles or food.

take-out-box.definition: A container for carrying food away from a shop.

display-case.definition: A glass-fronted counter or cabinet used to display ice cream or other products.

scoop-tool.definition: A utensil used to serve rounded portions of ice cream.
scoop-tool.exampleUsage: The scoop tool was used during the activity.

soft-serve-machine.definition: A machine that dispenses soft ice cream.
soft-serve-machine.exampleUsage: The soft serve machine was used during the activity.

waffle-iron.definition: A kitchen appliance that bakes waffles between two hinged metal plates, whose recessed surfaces press a pattern into the cooked waffle.

topping-bar.definition: A counter offering toppings to add to ice cream.

cash-register.definition: A store machine that records purchases, adds their prices, and prints a receipt for the customer.
cash-register.exampleUsage: The cash register was used during the activity.

menu.definition: A list of the ice creams, food, and drinks available to order.

chalkboard.definition: A dark board on which people write with chalk.

counter.definition: A service surface where staff take orders or serve customers.

line.definition: A formation of people or things one behind another.

bench.definition: A long seat that can hold more than one person.

umbrella.definition: A large cover above outdoor tables that provides shade or shelter.

sign.definition: A board showing rules or information.

awning.definition: A canopy made of canvas to shelter people or things from rain or sun.

neon-light.definition: A bright colored light made using an electrically charged gas inside a glass tube, often used for signs.
neon-light.exampleUsage: A pink neon light glowed above the shop counter.

outdoor-seating.definition: A designated outdoor area where seats are placed and arranged for people to sit.

cup.definition: A small paper or plastic container holding ice cream scoops.

spoon.definition: A shallow oval utensil used to eat desserts.

bowl.definition: A rounded open container for serving sundaes.

freezer.definition: A deep sub-zero refrigerated display holding tubs of ice cream.

blender.definition: An electric machine that purees milkshakes smoothly.

window.definition: A glass pane framing views of the storefront.

trash-can.definition: A waste container for paper napkins and disposable spoons.
